name: Cobb Cubed 2020
information: # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Competition will begin before the library opens for the day and end after the library closes. However, competitors will still have access to the Community Room through the main sliding doors of the library. Additional rounds of 6x6 and 7x7 will be added if time pemits. Please check your email the week prior to the competition for important information!
